mapper.sql: res.id, res.user_id, res.resource_id, res.client_request_id, res.start_at, res.end_at, res.accepted_at, res.arrival_deadline, res.status, res.cancel_reason, res.check_in_at, res.check_out_at, res.created_at, res.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (user_id, resource_id, client_request_id, start_at, end_at, accepted_at, arrival_deadline, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{resourceId}, #{clientRequestId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{acceptedAt}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO reservation_event (reservation_id, event_type, operator_id, occurred_at, request_id, reason) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{eventType}, #{operatorId}, #{occurredAt}, #{requestId}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT , r.name AS resource_name, r.resource_type, r.location, r.unit_label FROM reservation res JOIN resource r ON r.id = res.resource_id WHERE res.id = #{id} AND res.user_id = #{userId}
